description: Fetch assignments and quizzes for a specific course or all enrolled courses in D2L Brightspace. Shows dropbox (assignment) submissions and quizzes with due dates, status, and rubric info. Use this when the user asks about assignments, homework, dropboxes, dropbox folders, what to submit, quizzes, or assignment details and rubrics in Brightspace or D2L. Pass course with a name or code when you know it, or courseId when you have the ID. This is not get_assignment_files: it lists assignments and their status, it does not read the instruction PDFs or handouts attached to them. Example: "What assignments do I have in Calculus this week?"

course.description: Course name or code to get assignments for, for example "CS 101". Use this instead of courseId when you know the name.

courseId.description: Course ID to get assignments for. If omitted, returns assignments for all enrolled courses.

name: get_assignments
title: Get Assignments
